scope: offline native controller and ideal measured-joint feedback only; fixed 15-degree atlas knot; no force, tissue-contact, or acoustic outcome
selection_rule: at baked fixed rail all SRS branches 0..7 with swivel -180..175 in 5 degree increments; require checked FK, 35 configured collision pairs at >=10 mm, URDF and positive configured runtime arm margin; lexicographic min/max (margin, branch, swivel)

frozen_options.nominal_stage_timings_rule: max over three frozen variants of prior max(.55,1.68*distance_m/.027,1.68*turn_rad/.30)

exit_snapshot.restoration: replay all real controller updates from root, including all path/hold events; not a q-only reset or a partial private-state snapshot

events.provenance: physical observation hold 0.21s, no sensor or force signal manufactured
